items.item: Warns about the formula compiled-size limit (5,000 characters compiled) and that referencing other formulas counts their compiled size
items.evidence: "The compiled size cap is 5,000 characters, and the formula can nest only so many cross-formula references." It names the 5,000-character cap but never says that referenced formulas count their compiled size toward the total.

items.item: Offers an alternative if the limit is hit (for example a before-save flow or Apex that stores the value)
items.evidence: "we may have to split the score into two intermediate formulas." This is still formula-based. It doesn't offer a flow or Apex that stores the value.
